summary: Aman Gupta is a high-profile Indian entrepreneur and media personality, best known as the co-founder of boAt and a recurring investor on Shark Tank India. He is currently building a new venture, OFF/BEAT, and positions himself as a champion for failed founders and young entrepreneurs. His public persona blends corporate success with a 'hustler' identity, leveraging significant social media influence (1.7M+ followers) to drive brand awareness and personal narrative.
